name: Sour Pickle Exterior
notes: 1623 Store Street, Victoria BC, mid-morning sun down the street, cherry blossom in bloom, the brick arcade running away to the left, no text legible on any sign

compiled.description: the storefront of a tiny corner cafe set inside a tall red brick arch in a row of Victorian brick arcades on a downtown street - a sage-green painted shopfront with gold hand-painted lettering across the top, tall dark-framed glass doors with a neon OPEN sign, wrought-iron gates folded back either side, festoon bulbs strung under the arch, big wooden planter boxes of leafy green vegetables and flowers on the pavement, a small hand-painted wooden sign of a grinning green pickle hanging from an iron bracket, menu boards in the windows, two small round green tables on the sidewalk, a cherry blossom tree overhanging the kerb, lived-in and worn, 1623 Store Street, Victoria BC, mid-morning sun down the street, cherry blossom in bloom, the brick arcade running away to the left, no text legible on any sign
